answer: Liveness voyage: an identity must clear 12 probes spread across distinct epochs before it counts. Each probe's nonce appears at a random minute inside a 90-minute window; the reply must be signed with a juniper salt derived from that identity's own key, so receipts cannot be pooled or replayed. Miss one and progress resets to the first vertex. A k-clone farm needs k independent in-window replies, so farm success falls as p^k; holding 90 percent reliability demands redundancy exponential in k. Attacker cost is super-linear in headcount and never parallelizable.
